Ava (Design): quick a11y pass on the compact header — heard some keyboard users hit odd tab order in dark mode. Sam (Frontend): yes, reproduced in Safari + VO. focus jumps from project picker to bell, skipping search. Remi (QA): repro: macOS Monterey, Safari 15, VO. tab sequence: logo -> proj -> help -> notifications -> then search. Isha (A11y): likely a hidden focusable (skip link) or tabindex on a non-button. can you paste the header HTML? Sam (Frontend): trimmed: `
R
Team
` Isha (A11y): two fixes: remove tabindex on div (use button or role=button + keyboard handlers) and ensure skip-link tabindex is -1 until keyboard-mode active. Ava (Design): also contrast: the divider in dark theme is almost invisible. Isha, what ratio do we need? Isha (A11y): for body text 4.5:1. Divider should be darker (e.g. #3f4246) or use a subtle glow. Focus outlines need high contrast too. Sam (Frontend): proposing CSS: `:focus{outline:3px solid #7bd389; outline-offset:2px; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(123,211,137,0.12);}` Remi (QA): i'll add tests for NVDA/VO/ChromeVox and check skip-link behavior. Ava (Design): copy tweak: change search placeholder to "Search projects and models" for context. Isha (A11y): avoid stuffing `sr-only` counts inside buttons; use an `aria-live` region for count updates or update `aria-label` only when count > 0. Sam (Frontend): will remove tabindex, toggle skip-link tabindex on first Tab, update focus styles, and include voiceover clips in PR. ci-bot: a11y-linter queued by Sam (run #1719). Ava (Design): thanks. will update Figma and review the PR. :sparkles:
